# Source: NOAA-S/T 76-1562 = NASA-TM-X-74335, Part 4, Table I, document pages 68-73, which are pages 83-88 of
# the NTRS file https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19770009539 (19770009539.pdf).
#
# Columns: geometric altitude Z (m), density rho (kg/m^3), and rho/rho_0 where rho_0 = 1.2250 kg/m^3.
# Rows are every 1 km up to 300 km, every 2 km from 300 to 500 km, every 5 km from 500 to 1000 km; 401 in all.
#
# Notation is the report's own: "5.604-7" means 5.604e-7. As in the report, an exponent is printed only where
# it changes and holds down the column until the next one. Each number has four significant figures.
#
# The scan has no usable text layer, so these were read by eye from page images, then checked in several
# independent ways (docs/ATMOSPHERE.md). tools/ussa1976_table.py validates this file and generates the C++
# header from it.
